lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-torso with increased density and narrowing towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation visible on the 4th line from the anterior, which merges with the 5th line at the dorsal-lateral interface.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 10, 11, and 12 exhibit discontinuities, terminating in the mid-lateral region before reaching the ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots clustered on the lower posterior haunch above the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower haunch show a horizontal linear alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal band on the lower neck; white spots on the cheek and bridge of the muzzle; white chevron pattern between the eyes.
